from datetime import datetime, timezone
from src.scheduling.core import to_utc, reminder_hour_utc

# Test case provided in the prompt
# "2026-03-10T09:00:00-05:00" -> 14:00 UTC
start_time = datetime.fromisoformat("2026-03-10T09:00:00-05:00")
event = {"start": start_time}

utc_time = to_utc(event)
hour = reminder_hour_utc(event)

print(f"Original: {start_time}")
print(f"UTC: {utc_time}")
print(f"Hour: {hour}")

assert hour == 14, f"Expected 14, got {hour}"
